messages:
Maria Chen: Quick design check — latency dashboard prototype link: https://redwood.app/proto/latency-v2 :eyes: Maria Chen: Main issues I ran into on mobile narrow widths: - p95 card header is long and wraps, makes card height jump - the small delta badge overlaps the sparkline - time range picker pushes the sampling controls offscreen Alex Park: Agree on header. Proposal: 'P95 (ms)' and move delta into tooltip on hover / tap. :+1: Alisa Gomez: For keyboard users we should ensure the timepicker presets are reachable with arrow keys. Current markup doesn't expose focus order well. Proposed aria snippet: ```
``` Raj Patel: Heatmap colors — 50–75 and 75–90 look too similar at small sizes. Suggest increasing contrast and adding numeric ticks (25/50/75/95) on hover tooltip. Samir O'Neil: Sampling dropdown copy: we currently show 'Sampling: 10%'. UX asks for clarity — psuedo copy options: - 'Sampling rate: 10% of requests' (long) - 'Sample rate — 10%' (short) I prefer the short one but add a help icon linking to docs. Maria Chen: +1 to help icon. Also can we collapse sampling into an overflow menu on narrow screens? keeps top row tidy. DesignBot: Accessibility check: contrast failure on heatmap legend between 'mid' and 'high' swatches on mobile. Logged as ticket INF-487. Alex Park: Also noticed p95 tooltip language — should be 'P95 latency' not '95th percentile latency' in compact view (copy length). Short wins. Alisa Gomez: One more nit — focus style for selected preset should be a 3px outline (brand-accent) to meet 3:1 keyboard visibility. Raj Patel: I'll mock the compact header with those changes and push to the prototype branch by EOD. Will ping for a quick playtest. Maria Chen: Thanks team — if we can get copy + a11y fixes in the branch today I'll schedule a short dev handoff tomorrow. :rocket:
